games:2026-wk11-florida-kentucky.blurb: Aaron Philo, back in the starting lineup, piled up 221 all-purpose yards and ran in the go-ahead 2-yard score with 9:08 left as Florida knocked off No. 11 Kentucky 21-14 in Lexington. Jadan Baugh's 1-yard plunge was his SEC-leading 15th touchdown and the Gators got a safety to boot, while the Wildcats managed just one scoring drive after an opening 86-yard march and lost their second straight.

games:2026-wk11-usc-indiana.blurb: Grant Wilson threw for 305 yards and two touchdowns in his first start for No. 9 Indiana, and Khobie Martin's 1-yard run late in the third quarter broke the tie in a 27-13 win over No. 18 USC. The Trojans coughed it up three times, including a pair of late interceptions that sealed it, and Charlie Becker's 42-yard catch from Wilson put the game away.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-michigan-orego.blurb: Dylan Raiola threw for 341 yards and four touchdowns as No. 16 Oregon kept its playoff hopes breathing with a 31-7 win over Michigan. Savion Hiter's 70-yard run was the Wolverines' only answer; the Ducks hit on strikes of 60, 59 and 49 yards and forced two turnovers while winning their third straight.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-houston-colora.blurb: Colorado stunned No. 14 Houston 42-32 in Boulder, rallying from a 20-7 deficit late in the first half with 28 unanswered points and four touchdowns of 32 yards or more. DeKalon Taylor's 67-yard run and Joseph Williams' 53-yard catch from Isaac Wilson keyed the surge, and backup Kaneal Sweetwyne scored on his first snap after Wilson limped off; the Cougars' two turnovers and late two-point failures left them chasing all night.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-wake-forest-sm.blurb: No. 13 Wake Forest ran SMU out of Ford Stadium 49-7, building a 42-0 halftime lead behind Gio Lopez's two rushing touchdowns and a 44-yard scoring pass to Carlos Hernandez. The Demon Deacons forced three turnovers and pushed their winning streak to seven, handing the Mustangs their first home ACC loss.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-northwestern-o.blurb: Luke Fahey threw three touchdown passes and Jeremiah Smith caught 11 balls for 117 yards and a score as No. 20 Ohio State snapped a two-game skid with a 28-19 win over Northwestern. Smith became the Big Ten's career receiving yardage leader in the second quarter, and the Buckeyes overcame two turnovers to hold off a Northwestern team that kept it within one score into the fourth.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-alabama-vander.blurb: Keelon Russell, limited all week by an ankle injury, threw for 217 yards and three touchdowns -- two to Lotzeir Brooks -- as No. 3 Alabama ground out a 21-6 win at Vanderbilt. The Tide led just 7-3 at the half and committed two turnovers in a sloppy afternoon that fell well short of the 15.5-point number.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-duke-miami.blurb: Darian Mensah threw for 382 yards against his former school and Javian Mallory scored three times as No. 7 Miami beat Duke 36-25 to move closer to the ACC title game. Nate Sheppard kept the Blue Devils alive with 131 rushing yards, 93 receiving and two scores, but Mallory's 39-yard run in the fourth finally put the Hurricanes away.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-tennessee-texa.blurb: Cooper Ranvier booted a career-high five field goals and No. 8 Tennessee pulled away late for a 22-7 win at Texas A&M. The Aggies led 7-6 at the break before Faizon Brandon's 5-yard touchdown to DaSaahn Brame broke things open, and A&M's two second-half interceptions ended any comeback.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-boston-college.blurb: No. 5 Notre Dame showed no hangover from its win over Miami, racing to a 31-0 halftime lead and dismantling Boston College 41-7. CJ Carr threw touchdown passes to Micah Gilbert and Jordan Faison, and Jaylen Sneed returned a fumble a yard for a score as the Irish forced two Eagles turnovers.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State tumbled from 12th to 20th, but the models think the drop is overdone: SP+ still ranks the Buckeyes third and FPI fifth.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: The SEC's auto bid is the tightest race on the board: No. 1 Georgia leads with No. 3 Alabama just two spots back, close enough that one November slip flips the order.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: UCLA holds the Big Ten's automatic spot at No. 4 with No. 9 Indiana five spots behind -- a real cushion, but not one that survives a Bruins loss.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: No. 7 Miami controls the ACC's bid with No. 13 Wake Forest six spots back, meaning the Demon Deacons likely need the title game to close that gap themselves.

bubbleNotes:houston.blurb: Houston moved up three spots to the 15 seed but remains three spots outside the field, leaving little room for error the rest of the way.

bubbleNotes:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest climbed three spots to No. 14, now just two shy of the field, with no ranked team on deck to accelerate the rise.

games:2026-wk11-utah-arizona.blurb: Devon Dampier accounted for four touchdowns and hit Creed Whittemore for a 70-yard strike with 2:25 left as No. 2 Utah survived Arizona 40-39 in Tucson, staying unbeaten at 10-0. The Utes dug out of an early 11-point hole despite two turnovers, and Noah Fifita's second TD pass to Isaiah Mizell had put the Wildcats up six before Dampier answered.

games:2026-wk11-texas-lsu.blurb: Arch Manning threw three interceptions and then threw the only one that mattered, finding Raleek Brown from four yards out with three seconds left to lift No. 6 Texas past LSU 22-21 in Baton Rouge. The Longhorns took the lead for the first time since the opening quarter on that final play of a six-turnover night, keeping their playoff case alive while all but ending LSU's.

games:2026-wk11-missouri-georgia.blurb: Georgia scored on its first five possessions and buried Missouri 48-21 in Athens, with Nate Frazier punching in three short touchdown runs and Gunner Stockton adding a rushing score and a 12-yard TD pass to Isiah Canion. A Raylen Wilson interception on the game's first snap set up the opening score, and the Tigers' three touchdowns came long after the issue was settled.

games:2026-wk11-texas-tech-oklahoma-stat.blurb: Malcolm Simmons took the opening kickoff 97 yards and Thomas Castellanos threw four touchdown passes as No. 12 Texas Tech rolled into Stillwater and beat Oklahoma State 52-27 as an underdog. The Cowboys answered a 21-0 hole with a 17-0 run, but Castellanos' 45-yard scoring pass to Simmons early in the third put the Red Raiders back in control for good.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-illinois-ucla.blurb: Ty Dieffenbach left with a left elbow injury before halftime, returned late in the third quarter and threw for 232 yards and two scores as No. 4 UCLA stayed perfect with a rainy 22-14 win over Illinois. Aidan Mizell went for 176 receiving yards and a 54-yard touchdown, and Scooter Jackson's second interception with 2:50 left sealed the Bruins' 10-0 start.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-south-carolina.blurb: Four South Carolina turnovers turned into a 34-6 Arkansas rout in Fayetteville, with KJ Jackson throwing second-quarter touchdowns to Chris Marshall and Antonio Jordan and Joker Johnson taking an interception 63 yards to the house. The No. 17 Gamecocks, favored by 6.5, went 1 for 5 in the red zone and saw a four-game winning streak end.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-ole-miss-oklah.blurb: No. 19 Ole Miss heads to Norman as a 2.5-point road underdog, but ESPN's model actually leans the other way, giving the Rebels a 60% win probability. With a 48.5 total, this projects as a grind where every possession swings Ole Miss's at-large case.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-baylor-byu.blurb: Bear Bachmeier ran for three touchdowns and threw for a fourth as No. 10 BYU ground out a 28-7 win over Baylor in Provo. The Cougars leaned on the run on 47 of their snaps and scored on their first three drives; Baylor didn't reach the end zone until DJ Lagway found Matthew Klopfenstein in the fourth quarter.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-purdue-iowa.blurb: Hank Brown ran for a score and threw a short pass that Braeden Jackson turned into a 44-yard touchdown as No. 15 Iowa beat Purdue 28-7 for its third straight win. LJ Phillips rushed for 123 yards behind a 434-yard offense while the Hawkeye defense held the Boilermakers to their lowest point total of the season.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-oregon-state-b.blurb: Rasean Jones caught 11 passes for 230 yards and three touchdowns and Maddux Madsen threw for a career-best 371 yards as No. 24 Boise State outlasted Oregon State 46-41 to lock up the host spot for the Pac-12 title game. Travis Anderson's 58-yard pick-six in the first quarter helped the Broncos get out front, and they needed every bit of it to win their ninth straight.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky tumbled from No. 6 to No. 11, and the analytics have never been as high on the Wildcats as the poll was — SP+ has them 41st and FPI 34th.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA climbed from No. 8 to No. 4 at 10-0, and SP+ is on board at No. 11, though FPI's 25th-place read is a reminder the metrics still lag the record.

predictions:south-carolina.blurb: South Carolina moved up to No. 17 from 21st, but the models are lukewarm at best — 28th in SP+, 33rd in FPI.

predictions:ole-miss.blurb: Ole Miss slid from No. 10 to No. 19, with FPI (13th) still believing considerably more than SP+ (30th) does.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: Utah sits at No. 2 atop the Big 12 with BYU the closest chaser at No. 10 — an eight-spot gap that makes the league's automatic bid the Utes' to lose.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech jumped three spots to the 13 seed and is now just one place outside the field, with a date against the No. 25 team up next.

bubbleNotes:iowa.blurb: Iowa surged four spots to the 16 seed, still four places from the cut line but trending the right way.
